headline: Reserve Bank of India Announces 108 Billion Rupee State Securities Switch
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced a conversion and switch auction of state government securities totaling 10,800 crore rupees across multiple Indian state governments.
why: The Reserve Bank of India acts as the debt manager for central and state governments. Security switch auctions help state governments manage debt maturity profiles and reduce refinancing risk.

impacts.name: Indian State Development Loans
impacts.why: The auction allows Indian state governments to exchange shorter-dated debt securities for longer-dated destination securities.
